BiblicalUsage: An error is a sin done without knowing it, and the law made room for it. If any of the common people sin through ignorance, the priest shall make atonement and it shall be forgiven them, and the cities of refuge stand for the one who kills any person unawares. But the preacher warns not to call it an error before the angel: suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ignorance does not make a sin nothing, but God provided a way back for it. Atonement covers the sin we did not mean, and the refuge city kept the unknowing manslayer alive, and I hold that Christ is that refuge for me.
